% Adapted from the TeX Live 2025 tkz-euclide symmedian construction.
\documentclass[varwidth=true,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tkz-euclide}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=.8]
  \tkzDefPoints{0/0/A,4/0/B,0/3/C}
  \tkzDefMidPoint(A,C)\tkzGetPoint{M}
  \tkzDefLine[bisector](A,B,C)\tkzGetPoint{I}
  \tkzDefLine[symmedian](A,B,C)\tkzGetPoint{S}

  \tkzDrawPolygon[teal](A,B,C)
  \tkzDrawSegments[dashed,gray](B,M B,I)
  \tkzDrawLine[add=1 and 1,red](B,S)
  \tkzDrawPoints[red](A,B,C,M,I,S)
  \tkzLabelPoint[below](A){$A$}
  \tkzLabelPoint[right](B){$B$}
  \tkzLabelPoint[above](C){$C$}
  \tkzLabelPoint[left](M){$M$}
  \tkzLabelPoint[right](I){$I$}
  \tkzLabelPoint[below left](S){$S$}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
